label: EIGRP
notes: EIGRP packet header directly over IP protocol 88 (the IPv4 and IPv6 protocol numbers are common, RFC 7868 section 6.1). The fixed 20-byte header is fully modelled; the TLV chain that follows is variable-length and not modelled. scapy's EIGRP class models the trailing word as a single 4-byte AS field with no Virtual Router ID, so the recipe builds the RFC 7868 wire layout (VRID then 16-bit AS) through a corrective header class in tools/pktspec.py; every offset below is probe-verified against those bytes.

fields.label: Header Version
fields.description: EIGRP packet header format version; 2 in current deployments. Distinct from the TLV version.

fields.label: Sequence Number
fields.description: Per-sender sequence number; 0 means no acknowledgment is required.

fields.label: Acknowledgment Number
fields.description: The sequence number being acknowledged; 0 means no acknowledgment is present.

fields.label: Virtual Router ID
fields.description: 0 for the unicast address family, 1 for the multicast address family; packets with unknown values are discarded.

fields.label: Autonomous System Number
fields.description: 16-bit AS number of the sending system; packets from a mismatched AS are ignored.
